rationale: Accepted the need for concrete CalcDelta shape, but kept it as baseline contract language to avoid over-locking transport/API mechanics.
Unified NodeId graph model clarifies heterogeneous evaluation entities and aligns with current formal-core direction.
Included baseline dirty-closure model as a pathfinder-validated companion while retaining invariant model as normative formal target.
External invalidation and volatile invalidation require explicit separation to preserve predictable incremental behavior.
Adopted three-category volatility model while keeping built-in classification profile-governed rather than hard-coding function lists in doctrine.
Control/chart lifecycle needs explicit operation kinds for replayability and no-hidden-mutation compliance.
Promoted controls/charts as engine entities with dependency participation, but kept details concise at architecture level.
Captured pathfinder progress asymmetry as dated snapshot and explicit exit-blocker statement without redefining doctrine gates.
CHARTER is mission/doctrine-first; volatile implementation-status annotations belong in architecture/operations status sections instead.
Glossary expansion is valuable but currently too implementation-specific for CHARTER short glossary; revisit once terms stabilize across profiles.
Added explicit status terminology to prevent conflating local implementation exercise with Green-validated readiness.
Added candidate Round 1 pack names as planning anchors without making them current mandatory Round 0 gates.
Concrete artifact filename inventories are useful but too time-variant for normative operations section; retain in synthesis artifacts instead.
Track decomposition added as planning lens while preserving existing hard gate authority from required artifacts and packs.
Pathfinder feedback loop is now an explicit reusable synthesis-process pattern with required proposal structure.
